text.offer: Our fighters are few, but each is worth three of the Duke's. One of our war-priests has asked to fight beside you: a scimitar at your side and Kraanan's blessings on your back. Say the word and they are yours.
text.progress: Stand before the rebels' leader and ask for a companion (the Companion tab, C).
text.complete: Watch each other's backs. They will keep Kraanan's favour on you, and more of it as you grow. That is how we have survived this long.

steps.objective: Take a companion into your service
steps.brief: Stand before the rebels' leader and ask for a companion (the Companion tab, C).
